services.name: Full Groom Package
services.description: Bath, brushing, haircut, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and finishing spray.

services.name: Bath & Brush
services.description: A gentle bath, blow-dry, and thorough brushing.

services.name: Nail Trim
services.description: A quick, gentle nail trim for comfortable paws.

faqs.question: Does the Full Groom Package include nail trimming?
faqs.answer: Yes! It includes a bath, brushing, haircut, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and finishing spray.

faqs.question: Do you accept large breeds?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Golden retrievers and other large breeds are welcome.

faqs.question: What should I bring to the appointment?
faqs.answer: Please bring your dog on a leash and their current vaccination records.
